Contracts break down for many reasons: missed deliveries, unpaid work, unclear terms. We analyse the agreement and the conduct of both sides, advise on rights and remedies and pursue or defend the claim through negotiation or the courts.

We also review contracts before they are signed, which is almost always cheaper than disputing them afterwards.
